# Omarchy App Drawer

Omarchy App Drawer is an application launcher plugin for Omarchy. The site describes its interface, installation, keyboard use, configuration, and release history.

## Documentation

- Overview: https://bolens.github.io/omarchy-app-drawer/
- Changelog: https://bolens.github.io/omarchy-app-drawer/changelog/

## Source

- Repository: https://github.com/bolens/omarchy-app-drawer
- Issues: https://github.com/bolens/omarchy-app-drawer/issues
